messages.text: I get a Bad gateway Error code 502 in harlo vision?
Handed to the team · Web dashboard error I can't diagnose from product data

A 502 is server side, not your miner, so nothing is broken on your end. First thing to try: hard refresh the page (Ctrl+Shift+R, or Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac), and if it persists, sign out and back in. That clears it most of the time.

Is it happening on every page of Vision, or just one screen?

I've passed it to JD, who handles the firmware and Vision side. The team's offline until 10am ET today and the answer comes to your email, so you don't need to wait here.

Just so we're clear, do you mean it's been doing this since Saturday? And you won't be waiting until Saturday for an answer, JD picks this up today at 10am ET and replies by email.

Before you go, one thing: when Vision goes down like this, does your miner keep hashing, or are you worried it's stopped?

Good, that's the important part. The miner hashes on its own, Vision is just the window into it, so a 502 there doesn't cost you any work.

One more: did the 502 start after a firmware update, or did it just appear on its own?
